title: Ceiling Finish Decision
short_answer: Job Start has Ceiling finish and Garage finish because crews otherwise build yesterday's job.
summary: Job Start has Ceiling finish and Garage finish because crews otherwise build yesterday's job.
plain_words: Job Start has Ceiling finish and Garage finish because crews otherwise build yesterday's job. Read those fields, then the RCP / finish schedule. If they disagree, that is an RFI or an office call — not a coin flip in the driveway.

steps.body: Do not assume full finish if the packet says otherwise.

steps.body: know where systems meet before stock lands.

steps.body: if ACT sits under a rated path, do not invent the above-ceiling detail; ask.
